groups.label: For Attorney
groups.sharedSubject: NEW INSTRUCTION: PROVIDING OF LEGAL REPRESENTATION TO <RANK> <INIT_SURNAME> - <MATTER_TYPE>, <LOCATION> <COURT_TYPE> (<DATE>)

templates.label: First Contact
templates.body:
Good day, I trust all is well

{{TELEPHONIC_LINE}}

Kindly find attached an instruction for your perusal and reply

{{DOCS_LINE}}

The matter details:
- **Type:** <MATTER_TYPE>
- **For:** <RANK_SHORT> <INIT_SURNAME>
- **Location:** <LOCATION>
- **Date:** <DATE>

We trust to hear back from you as soon as is convenient
Thank you kindly for your consideration

templates.label: Other Attorney Already Accepted
templates.body:
Good day, I trust all is well,

Thank you kindly for your response on the matter,

Unfortunately, another attorney has gotten back to us sooner, and has already accepted the instruction

We do appreciate your willingness to accept and assist with our matter

Thank you kindly once again and have a wonderful day

templates.label: Undertaking
templates.body:
Good day, I trust all is well

{{TELEPHONIC_LINE}}

Thank you for the acceptance of the matter.

Kindly find attached the Attorneys Undertaking for your signature and return.

{{DOCS_LINE}}

The members contact details, should you require them are:
- **Member:** <RANK_SHORT> <INIT_SURNAME>
- **Contact:** <MEMBER_CONTACT>

We thank you once again for your acceptance of this matter, it is greatly appreciated.

sentTogether.label: Undertaking + Instruction
sentTogether.body:
Good day, I trust all is well,

{{TELEPHONIC_LINE}}

Kindly find attached the Instruction and Attorneys Undertaking for your signature and return.

{{DOCS_LINE}}

The member's contact details are as follows:
- **Member:** <RANK_SHORT> <INIT_SURNAME>
- **Contact:** <MEMBER_CONTACT>

Thank you again
